repos.description: 发现导航，好用强大轻量级导航网站 Discover navigation, easy to use, powerful lightweight navigation website
repos.summary_zh: 发现导航是一个纯静态、支持SEO的轻量级导航网站，内置800+优质网站资源。它无需数据库和服务器，支持在线编辑、AI翻译、书签导入导出、暗黑模式、多主题切换及响应式设计，提供后台管理及自动化部署功能，适用于个人或企业内网统一链接管理。
repos.summary_en: Discover Navigation is a pure static, SEO-friendly lightweight navigation website featuring over 800 curated sites. Built without databases or servers, it supports online editing, AI translation, bookmark import/export, dark mode, multi-theme switching, responsive design, admin panel, and automated deployment—ideal for personal or enterprise internal link management.

repos.description: 发现导航 , 好用强大轻量级导航网站 Discover navigation, easy to use, powerful lightweight navigation website
repos.summary_zh: 发现导航是一个纯静态、支持SEO的轻量级导航网站，内置800+优质链接，具备AI翻译、书签导入导出、多主题切换、暗黑模式、响应式设计等强大功能，支持无服务器部署和在线管理，适用于个人或企业内网导航。
repos.summary_en: Discover Navigation is a pure static, SEO-friendly lightweight navigation site with 800+ curated links. It features AI translation, bookmark import/export, multi-theme support, dark mode, responsive design, and no-server deployment, suitable for personal or enterprise internal navigation.

repos.description: 租房要点，适用于北上广深杭，欢迎补充。
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库整理了中国一线城市（北上广深杭）租房核心要点，聚焦避坑指南与实操策略，涵盖直租识别、中介甄别、合同陷阱防范及合租注意事项，强调实地验房与房东资质核查，旨在帮助租客规避常见纠纷、保障居住安全与权益。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles essential rental tips for major Chinese cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hangzhou), focusing on avoiding pitfalls and practical strategies. It covers identifying direct landlord rentals, vetting agents, contract traps, and co-living safety, emphasizing on-site inspections and landlord qualification checks to protect tenants from disputes and unsafe housing.

repos.description: NaviHive 是一个精美的个人网站导航管理系统，帮助你整理和管理你收藏的网站链接。支持分组管理、拖拽排序、暗色模式等功能，让你的网站收藏更有条理、更易访问。
repos.summary_zh: NaviHive 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建的现代化个人网站导航管理系统，支持分组管理、拖拽排序和暗色模式。采用 React + TypeScript + Material UI 技术栈，零成本部署于全球 CDN，提供企业级安全与快速访问体验。
repos.summary_en: NaviHive is a modern personal website navigation management system built on Cloudflare Workers. It supports grouping, drag-and-drop sorting, and dark mode. Powered by React, TypeScript, and Material UI, it offers zero-cost deployment with global CDN acceleration and enterprise-grade security.

repos.summary_zh: AndroidCat 是一个专为 Android 开发者打造的网址导航集合，涵盖资源文档、技术社区、教程、开源项目等八大类别，提供官方文档、设计指南、开发框架、技术资讯等一站式学习资源，助力开发者高效获取 Android 开发所需工具和知识。
repos.summary_en: AndroidCat is a curated collection of Android development resources, serving as a comprehensive navigation hub for developers. It aggregates official documentation, design guidelines, frameworks, tutorials, open-source projects, and tech communities across eight categories, enabling efficient access to essential tools and knowledge for Android development.

repos.description: ✨一个部署在CF的轻量化导航页面，可移动卡片式书签，方便管理
repos.summary_zh: Card-Tab 是一个部署在 Cloudflare Workers 上的轻量化书签管理页面，采用卡片式布局支持拖拽排序、分类管理和暗色主题切换。具备多搜索引擎集成、JWT登录验证、KV存储备份及实时天气显示等功能，适合个人快速搭建个性化导航站。
repos.summary_en: Card-Tab is a lightweight bookmark management page deployed on Cloudflare Workers, featuring card-based layout with drag-and-drop sorting, custom categories, dark mode, and multi-engine search. It supports JWT authentication, KV storage backups, and real-time weather display for personalized navigation.

repos.description: Urban governance - Where is the restroom?
repos.summary_zh: 该应用为解决城市如厕难问题，提供附近2公里内卫生间实时搜索、导航及基础信息查询，集成地图、天气、文章推荐等功能，采用高德地图、七牛云存储、微信公众号及阿里云部署，展示如何快速构建实用型移动应用。
repos.summary_en: This app addresses urban restroom accessibility by enabling users to search nearby toilets within 2km, view basic info, and get navigation. It integrates map services, weather, articles, and uses platforms like Amap, Qiniu Cloud, WeChat, and Aliyun for rapid deployment of a practical mobile solution.

repos.description: 【abcd修改版-个人用】托管在cloudflare上的轻量化导航，可以同步谷歌书签
repos.summary_zh: CloudNav-abcd 是基于 Cloudflare Pages 的免费个人导航站，支持谷歌书签同步、AI智能分类与简介生成、WebDAV双重备份及密码保护。提供拖拽排序、右键快捷操作、Chrome扩展插件等高效功能，适配多端访问，适合个人知识管理。
repos.summary_en: CloudNav-abcd is a free personal navigation site hosted on Cloudflare Pages, supporting Google bookmark sync, AI-powered auto-categorization and descriptions, WebDAV dual backup, and password protection. Features drag-and-drop sorting, right-click shortcuts, Chrome extension, and cross-device access for efficient knowledge management.

repos.description: 工作生活的唠叨/随笔、折腾备忘, 同时分享下观看的影视、减肥动起来的记录等。Hugo theme and personal blog system with essays, microblog-style updates, browser publishing and life data.
repos.summary_zh: Koobai/blog 是一个个人博客仓库，专注于记录工作生活感悟、技术折腾笔记及日常软件推荐。内容涵盖影视观后感、减肥健身打卡等生活化主题，兼具实用性与分享性，适合追求轻量化知识沉淀与兴趣交流的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Koobai/blog is a personal blog repository focused on daily life musings, technical experimentation notes, and software recommendations. It covers topics like movie reviews, fitness tracking, and lifestyle tips, offering a blend of practical insights and casual sharing for developers seeking lightweight knowledge documentation.

repos.summary_zh: djangoBaidusitemap 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于动态生成百度地图 XML 站点地图，支持 HTML5、WML 和 XHTML 多格式 URL 输出，兼容 Django 内置 sitemap 机制，适用于 SEO 优化与多终端内容分发。
repos.summary_en: djangoBaidusitemap is a Django extension that dynamically generates Baidu XML sitemaps, supporting multi-format URLs (HTML5, WML, XHTML), compatible with Django's built-in sitemap framework, ideal for SEO optimization and cross-platform content delivery.
